headline: Missed a few days? Start with Catch Me Up.
summary: Use Catch Me Up for a recent return; use the archive when you need one older thing.
body: On a new device, Catch Me Up starts with the last seven days. Once a NewsStand visit is saved on that device, it starts from that visit and shows the available stories and columns.
For a particular older piece, use the archive. Choose From and To dates, then narrow by topic, theme or concept.
Catch Me Up is for a quick return; the archive is for a deliberate search. The dates stay attached, so an older report does not quietly become today’s news.

recheckTriggers: Catch Me Up, archive controls, saved-visit behaviour, or public availability changes.
Recheck before selecting for a dated issue; a bank draft is not publication permission.
